item.title: NEC Fact-Finding Committee: Roh Tae-ak Only Learned of 50% Ballot Reduction Guidelines After Incident (선관위 진상규명위 “노태악, 투표지 50% 축소인쇄지침 사태 이후 인지”)
item.description:
<<>> Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairman Roh Tae-ak was found to have been unaware of the decision to reduce ballot printing rates, which caused the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, until after the incident. Investigations revealed that Roh only learned of the existence of the printing reduction guidelines after the ballot shortage occurred. ()

Jo Hyeon-uk, head of the NEC's Fact-Finding Committee on the ballot shortage, held the 6th meeting on the 17th and stated in a briefing, "Through written responses from the NEC chairman, standing commissioner, secretary-general, and deputy secretary-general, we confirmed whether the NEC was informed during the dissemination of the '50% ballot reduction guidelines' and whether reports and responses were made on election day regarding the situation." He added, "Regarding the 'reduction in the number of ballots printed on election day' (50% lower limit), the NEC chairman responded that he had not been briefed before the guidelines were implemented." He further noted, "Former Chairman Roh stated that he only learned of the existence of the ballot reduction guidelines after the incident occurred." ( 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원회 위원장이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 원인이 된 투표용지 인쇄비율 축소 결정을 사전에 인지하지 못했던 것으로 드러났다. 노 전 위원장은 인쇄비율 축소 지침의 존재를 투표용지 부족사태가 벌어진 뒤에서야 알게 된 것으로 조사됐다. )

Previously, on December 10 of last year, the NEC revised the comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide local elections under the authority of the secretary-general. The guidelines included a clause stating, "If a reduction in the number of ballots printed on election day is deemed necessary based on expected early voting rates and voter turnout in recent elections, it can be adjusted by a commission resolution to a lower limit of 50% of the number of voters." This reduced the lower limit for ballot printing from 60% to 50%, which became the root cause of the ballot shortage on the 3rd. ( 조현욱 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회 위원장은 17일 제6차 회의를 연 뒤 브리핑을 통해 “중앙선관위 위원장, 상임위원, 사무총장, 사무차장의 서면질의서 회신을 통해 ‘(투표용지) 50% 축소인쇄 지침’ 시달과정에서 중앙선관위의 보고 여부, 본투표 당일 사태에 대한 보고 및 대응 여부를 확인했다”며 “‘선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수 축소’(50% 하한)에 대하여 중앙선관위 위원장은 지침 시행 전에 보고받은 바가 없다고 회신했다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “(노 전) 중앙선관위 위원장은 이번 사태 발생 후에 투표용지 인쇄축소 지침의 존재를 알게 됐다고 한다”고 덧붙였다. )

It was also revealed that former Chairman Roh only learned of the ballot shortage on election day through media reports. Chairman Jo stated, "The NEC learned of the ballot shortage not through a report from the Seoul Election Commission but via media reports, and simultaneously received reports from the standing commissioner and secretary-general." He added, "Around 5:08 PM on that day, they became aware of the ballot shortage and considered issuing ballots through ballot dispensing machines, but it was already too late for an appropriate response." Chairman Jo further added that the Seoul Election Commission's decision to extend voting hours until 10 PM was not reported to former Chairman Roh in advance. ( 앞서 중앙선관위는 지난해 12월10일 ‘사무총장 전결’로 제9회 전국동시지방선거 종합관리지침을 개정했다. 해당 지침에는 “선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수는 예상 사전투표율 및 최근 선거의 투표율 등을 감안하여 축소인쇄 필요성이 인정되는 경우 위원회 의결로 선거인수 50%(하한)를 기준으로 조정 가능하다”는 대목이 들어갔다. 이에 따라 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한은 기존 60%에서 50%로 줄었다. 이는 지난 3일 투표용지 부족 사태의 근본적 원인이 됐다. )

Chairman Jo said, "Given that the NEC did not receive prior reports from the Songpa-gu Election Commission or the Seoul Election Commission about the ballot shortage, it is clear that the rapid reporting and response system for emergency situations was not functioning." ( 노 전 위원장이 선거 당일 투표용지 부족사태를 언론 보도를 통해서야 알게 된 것도 드러났다. 조 위원장은 “중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족사태를 서울시 선관위로부터 보고 받은 게 아니라 언론보도를 통해 알게 됐고 그와 동시에 상임위원, 사무총장 등으로 보고를 받았다고 한다”며 “당일 오후 5시8분 무렵 투표용지 부족 사안을 인지하고 투표용지 발급기를 통한 발급 등을 검토했지만 이미 너무 늦어 적절한 대처가 되지 못했다”고 했다. 아울러, 서울시 선관위가 오후 10시까지 투표 시간을 연장한 결정도 노 전 위원장은 사전에 보고받지 못했던 것으로 확인됐다고 조 위원장은 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 조 위원장은 “투표용지 부족상황에 대해 중앙선관위가 송파구 선관위, 서울시 선관위로부터 사전 보고를 받지 못한 점을 볼 때 비상상황에 대한 신속한 보고·대응 체계가 미작동함을 알 수 있었다”고 밝혔다. )

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae to Attend President Lee’s Homecoming Event…Will the ‘Lee-Jung Conflict’ Be Mended? (이 대통령 귀국 행사에 정청래 참석…‘명-청 갈등’ 봉합될까)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok are set to attend the welcoming ceremony for President Lee Jae-myung’s return on the 18th after concluding his European tour. This is seen as an attempt by the presidential office to patch up the deepening internal strife within the ruling camp, known as the ‘Lee-Jung conflict,’ which has been fueling controversy. (유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 복귀하는 이재명 대통령의 귀국 환영 행사에 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 김민석 국무총리 등이 참석한다. ‘명-청 갈등’으로 불리는 여권 내 내홍이 깊어지고 이로 인한 논란도 확산하자 청와대가 일단 봉합에 나선 것으로 풀이된다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung announced to the media on the 17th, “Tomorrow’s welcome event for President Lee’s return will be attended by government officials including the Prime Minister and the Vice Minister of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, as well as the party leadership including the party leader and the floor leader of the Democratic Party.” Earlier, at the send-off event for President Lee’s overseas trip on the 9th, only Prime Minister Kim attended, while the ruling party leadership, including leader Jung, were absent at the direction of the presidential office. At the time, the presidential office explained that “the number of attendees was minimized in consideration of domestic circumstances, such as the prolonged Middle East war and the poor management by the National Election Commission.” However, political circles interpreted this as a deliberate exclusion of leader Jung. Following President Lee’s public criticism of the ruling party leadership, including leader Jung, during his first-year anniversary press conference on the 8th, many viewed Jung’s unprecedented exclusion from the send-off event the next day as President Lee’s way of backing Prime Minister Kim over leader Jung, who is mentioned as a potential candidate for the August 17 party convention. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 17일 언론 공지를 내어 “내일 이 대통령 귀국 환영 행사에는 국무총리, 행정안전부 차관 등 정부 인사와 당대표, 원내대표 등 민주당 지도부가 참석할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 앞서 지난 9일 이 대통령 순방 환송 행사 때는 김 총리만 참석하고 정 대표 등 여당 지도부는 청와대 뜻으로 불참한 바 있다. 당시 청와대는 “중동 전쟁 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등 국내 상황을 염두에 둬 환송 인원을 최소화했다”고 설명했지만, 정치권에서는 의도적인 정 대표 배제란 해석이 나왔다. 이 대통령이 지난 8일 취임 1년 기자회견에서 정 대표 등 여당 지도부를 공개 비판한 데 이어, 이튿날 정 대표가 이례적으로 환송 행사 참석 명단에서 제외된 것을 두고 이 대통령이 8·17 전당대회 주자로 거론되는 정 대표와 김 총리 가운데 김 총리에게 힘을 실어준 것이란 시각이 많았다.)

Within and outside the Democratic Party, there is a prevailing view that while tensions between the party and the presidential office have temporarily eased, the behind-the-scenes maneuvering over leader Jung’s potential candidacy for the party convention will continue. At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Jung stated, “(This year’s party convention) will be the first to implement a one-person-one-vote system,” adding that “the one-person-one-vote system will lead to the dissolution of factions within the party.” This remark, re-emphasizing the abolition of weighted votes for delegates and equalizing the value of votes between delegates and paid party members, is seen as targeting party sentiment with an eye on running for the party leadership. At the meeting, Jung dismissed the distinction between ‘pro-Lee’ and ‘pro-Jung’ factions, or ‘pro-Jung’ and ‘pro-Seok’ (pro-Kim Min-seok) factions, calling it “malicious divisiveness,” and said, “If I must categorize myself, I am a member of the party’s reformist faction.” Within the party, there is growing weight behind the prediction that if Jung finalizes his intention to run, he will resign as party leader on the 24th, two days before the scheduled formation of the party convention preparatory committee, and officially declare his bid for re-election. (민주당 안팎에선 당-청 간 긴장이 일시적으로 완화됐으나 정 대표의 전당대회 출마 여부를 둘러싼 여권 내 신경전은 계속될 거란 관측이 지배적이다. 정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “(올해 전당대회는) 1인 1표제로 시행되는 첫 전당대회”라며 “1인 1표제로 당내 계파가 소멸할 것”이라고 말했다. 당대표와 최고위원 선거에서 대의원 표에 부여되던 가중치를 폐지하고 대의원과 권리당원의 표 가치를 동등하게 하는 1인 1표제를 다시 강조한 것으로, 전당대회 출마를 염두에 두고 당심을 겨냥한 발언으로 읽힌다. 정 대표는 이 자리에서 ‘친명’(친이재명), ‘친청’(친정청래) 구분 또는 ‘친청’, ‘친석’(친김민석) 구분에 대해 “악의적 갈라치기”라며 “저는 굳이 구분한다면 당원파고 개혁파”라고 했다. 당내에선 정 대표가 최종 출마 의지를 굳힐 경우 전당대회준비위원회 구성 예정일 이틀 전인 오는 24일 대표직에서 사퇴하고 연임 도전을 공식화할 거란 전망에 무게가 실린다.)

At the same meeting, figures within the party who have been at odds with Jung also targeted him. Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, who is close to Prime Minister Kim, remarked, “If a losing soccer manager and coaching staff write the match evaluation (the white paper on the June 3 local elections), who would trust the results? Party members are eternal, but party power is finite.” This was a direct retort to Jung’s message from the Supreme Council meeting on the 10th, where he said, “The people are eternal, and the government is short-lived,” a comment interpreted at the time as an indirect jab at President Lee. (정 대표와 각을 세워온 당내 인사들은 이날 회의에서도 정 대표를 겨냥했다. 김 총리와 가까운 강득구 최고위원은 “축구 경기에서 패배한 감독과 코치진이 경기 평가서(6·3 지방선거 평가 백서)를 직접 작성한다면 누가 그 결과를 신뢰하겠나”라며 “당원은 영원하지만 당권은 유한하다”고 말했다. 지난 10일 정 대표가 최고위원회의에서 한 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”는 메시지를 정 대표에게 고스란히 되돌려준 것이다. 당시 정 대표의 발언은 이 대통령을 에둘러 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다.)

It is also noteworthy that figures who had not taken sides in the conflict between the pro-power and anti-power factions are now calling on Jung not to run. Lawmaker Ki-heon Lee wrote on Facebook, “If the party convention held in the first year of the administration sees the party and government in conflict or competition, the momentum for governance over the next four years will inevitably be severely damaged. Jung should not run, and a stable management of the party convention must be ensured.” Lawmaker Seong-jun Jin appeared on YTN Radio the previous day and stated, “I don’t think Jung has much justification to challenge for re-election.” (당권파와 비당권파의 갈등 전선에 서지 않던 인사들까지 정 대표 불출마 요구에 나선 점도 주목된다. 이기헌 의원은 페이스북에 “집권 1년차에 맞이한 전당대회에서 당과 정부가 갈등하거나 경쟁하는 모습을 보인다면 향후 4년간 국정 운영의 동력은 심각하게 훼손될 수밖에 없다”며 “정 대표의 불출마와 함께 안정적인 전당대회 관리가 이뤄져야 한다”고 했다. 진성준 의원은 전날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오에 나와 “정 대표가 연임에 도전할 만한 명분은 많지 않다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Kim, who is considered a de facto candidate for the party convention, carried out schedules in the Honam region that day, including attending the Yeosu offshore wind power supply chain conference and exhibition and the completion ceremony for the electric furnace at POSCO’s Gwangyang Steelworks. A re-elected lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, “If we enter a ‘my-way’ competition just over a year into the administration ahead of the party convention, it will be like carrying a time bomb even after the convention ends. If the rift deepens further from here, the public will say, ‘We entrusted them with power, and they’re just fighting among themselves.’” (한편 전당대회 출마를 기정사실로 한 김 총리는 이날에도 전남 여수 해상풍력 공급망 콘퍼런스 전시회와 포스코 광양제철소 전기로 준공식에 참석하는 등 호남 일정을 소화했다. 한 수도권 재선 의원은 “집권 1년을 겨우 지난 시점에서 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘마이웨이’식 경쟁에 들어가면 전당대회가 끝나도 시한폭탄을 안고 가는 상황이 될 것”이라며 “여기서 더 갈등의 골이 깊어지면 국민은 권력을 맡겼더니 자기들끼리 싸우기나 하는구나 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae "Everyone is pro-Myung" vs. Jang Dong-hyuk "Full Re-election"… Wavering Commanders [Gongdeok-Pocha] (정청래 “모두 친명” vs 장동혁 “전면 재선거”… 흔들리는 사령탑들[공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

Ahead of the August 17 party convention, Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, has opted for a frontal breakthrough. At the Supreme Council meeting on the 17th, Representative Jung expressed displeasure, stating, "The talk of pro-Cheong and pro-Seok factions is malicious division," and declared, "Everyone in the Democratic Party is pro-Myung, wishing for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." The logic is that since everyone is pro-Myung, factional divisions are inherently fictitious. However, criticism is emerging that blaming the media is somewhat far-fetched, given that Jung’s own remark, "The regime is short," sparked the Myung-Cheong conflict theory. ()

Regarding the key pledge of the one-person-one-vote system, he emphasized, "If implemented, intra-party factions will disappear." Yet, given the reality that one-third of paid party members are concentrated in the Honam region, there is considerable counterargument that instead of factions vanishing, the situation will merely transform into a 'battle for party members' votes'. ( 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 정면돌파에 나섰습니다. 정 대표는 17일 최고위원회의에서 “친청파·친석파 운운은 악의적 갈라치기”라고 불쾌감을 드러내며, “민주당 모두는 이재명 정부의 성공을 바라는 친명”이라고 선언했습니다. 모두가 친명이니 계파 구분 자체가 허구라는 논리입니다. 다만 ‘정권은 짧다’는 정 대표 본인의 발언이 명·청 갈등설을 촉발했던 만큼, 책임을 언론에 돌리는 화법은 다소 무리가 있다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

The pressure is intense. In the 210,000-member 'Jaemyeong's Village,' a signature drive is underway calling for Representative Jung’s resignation and refusal to run for re-election. The conflict between Kwak Sang-eon and Yoo Si-min over the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation has also spilled over into clashes among supporters. On the opposing side, an alliance between Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil, who have simultaneously launched campaigns in Honam, is emerging. ( 핵심 공약인 1인1표제를 두고는 “시행되면 당내 계파가 소멸된다”고 강조했습니다. 그러나 권리당원의 3분의1이 호남에 몰린 현실에서, 계파가 사라지기보다 ‘당원 표심 쟁탈전’으로 모습만 바뀐다는 반론도 만만치 않습니다. )

The most painful aspect is the approval rating. President Yoon's negative job performance rating has surpassed the positive rating for the first time since his inauguration, and in party support, the People Power Party has overtaken the Democratic Party for the first time. Even the achievements of the overseas trips have been overshadowed. The moment one declares there are no factions, the cost is directly billed as a drop in approval ratings. item.title: President Lee and Trump Engage in Two-Hour Close Communication… Discuss Korea-US Alliance, Middle East Situation and Other Current Issues (이 대통령-트럼프 2시간 밀착 소통…한미동맹, 중동정세 등 현안 논의)
item.description:
<<>> The presidential office announced on the 17th that President Lee Jae-myung had a close exchange of opinions with US President Donald Trump on major issues including the Korea-US alliance, the Middle East situation, and the Korean Peninsula issue during the official dinner of the Group of Seven (G7) summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France on the 16th (local time). ()

President Lee met with President Trump at the official dinner hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife, congratulating him on the conclusion of ceasefire negotiations between the US and Iran. The two agreed on the importance of free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and shared expectations that the restoration of stability and peace in the Middle East would stabilize oil prices and revive the economy. President Lee reportedly had a conversation with President Trump, who was seated right next to him, for about two hours. ( 이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 공식 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 한-미 동맹, 중동 정세 및 한반도 문제를 포함한 주요 현안에 대해 긴밀한 의견을 교환했다고 청와대가 17일 밝혔다. )

President Lee also asked President Trump to pay attention to peace on the Korean Peninsula. In response, President Trump expressed a strong willingness to play a necessary role in advancing the Korean Peninsula issue and stated that he would consider ways to contribute to peace on the Korean Peninsula, according to the presidential office. President Trump also expressed his intention to communicate closely with President Lee regarding peace on the Korean Peninsula. ( 이 대통령은 이날 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령 부부가 주최한 공식 만찬에서 트럼프 대통령과 만나 미-이란 간 종전 협상이 타결된 것을 축하했다. 호르무즈해협 내 자유롭고 안전한 항행의 중요성에 대해서 의견을 같이하고, 중동 지역 내 안정과 평화가 회복됨으로써 유가가 안정되고 경제가 회복될 것이란 기대도 함께 나눴다. 이 대통령은 이날 트럼프 대통령의 바로 옆자리에서 2시간가량 대화를 나눴다고 한다. )

The two leaders exchanged views on expanding mutually beneficial cooperation in areas such as shipbuilding and shared consensus on the importance of trilateral cooperation between South Korea, the United States, and Japan based on a solid Korea-US alliance. President Trump evaluated President Lee as a 'strong leader' and expressed expectations that the two leaders would together contribute to peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, the presidential office added. ( 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령에게 한반도 평화를 위해 관심을 기울여줄 것을 주문하기도 했다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 한반도 문제 진전을 위해 필요한 역할을 해 나가겠다는 강력한 의지를 표명하고, 한반도 평화를 위한 기여 방안에 대해 고민하겠다고 밝혔다고 청와대는 전했다. 트럼프 대통령은 한반도 평화와 관련해 이 대통령과 긴밀히 소통해 나가겠다는 뜻도 함께 밝혔다. )

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 두 정상은 조선 분야 등에서의 호혜적 협력 확대 방안에 대해 의견을 교환하고, 굳건한 한-미 동맹을 토대로 한 한·미·일 협력의 중요성에 대해서도 공감대를 나타냈다. 트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령을 ‘강한 지도자’로 평가하며 양 정상이 함께 한반도 평화와 안보에 기여해나갈 수 있을 거라는 기대감을 표명했다고 청와대는 덧붙였다. )

item.title: ‘Jung Eui-han staged attack suspicion’ Reform Party: “Already left party sneakily… will respond without leniency” (‘정이한 피습 자작극 의혹’ 개혁신당 “이미 꼼수 탈당…무관용 대응”)
item.description:
The Reform Party has announced that it will take stern measures against Jung Eui-han, the Busan mayoral candidate for the June 3 local elections, who is under investigation over suspicions that his attack during a campaign rally was staged, stating that he has already “sneakily left the party.” <<> Cheon Ha-ram, the Reform Party’s floor leader, posted on Facebook on the 17th, saying: “As the chair of the nomination committee responsible for the party’s local election nominations, I feel a deep sense of responsibility and dismay over the controversy and behavior of former Busan mayoral candidate Jung Eui-han, who has shown extremely irresponsible attitudes such as abruptly leaving the party and cutting off contact,” and apologized, saying “I sincerely apologize for causing concern to the public and party members over this unfortunate incident.” <<> Floor leader Cheon stated: “Former candidate Jung submitted a resignation from the party abruptly using the online system to avoid the party’s condemnation and strict punishment for his wrongdoing” and called it “a cowardly ‘sneaky withdrawal’ exploiting the fact that party withdrawal takes immediate effect under the Party Act.” He added: “The Reform Party makes it clear that just because he has left physically, the wrongdoing does not disappear,” and announced that the party would △launch its own fact-finding team △take legal action without leniency △and impose a permanent ban on rejoining the party. <<> Earlier that day, the Weekly Chosun reported: “The Busan Geumjeong Police Station is investigating former candidate Jung Eui-han on charges of obstructing official duties by deception, publishing false information, and violating the Public Official Election Act.” <<> Candidate Jung, who ran for Busan mayor under the Reform Party, was campaigning on April 27 at around 8:05 a.m., handing out business cards to drivers waiting at a traffic light on a road near Sejeong Tower in Geumjeong-gu, Busan. At the time, Jung’s side claimed that a driver sprayed beverages from his car, causing Jung to fall while trying to avoid it and lose consciousness, after which he was taken to the hospital. Police arrested the driver, a man in his 30s, at around 2:20 p.m. that day. Later, Jung visited the man and submitted a leniency petition, and two days later, on the 29th, he returned to campaigning wearing a neck brace. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (개혁신당은 유세 중 피습 사건과 관련해 자작극 의혹으로 수사를 받고 있는 정이한 6·3지방선거 부산시장 후보가 이미 ‘꼼수 탈당’을 했다며 엄중 조처하겠다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Reform of the ‘Ownerless’ Election Commission: Audit by the Board of Audit and Inspection or an Independent Evaluation Committee? (‘주인 없는’ 선관위 개혁…감사원 감찰이냐, 독립 평가위냐)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) was established in 1963 as an independent constitutional body to prevent ‘government-managed elections’ following the fraudulent March 15, 1960 election, which sparked the April 19 Revolution, and has since contributed to the development of South Korean democracy. However, the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections has amplified calls for fundamental reform of the ‘63-year NEC system.’ The NEC’s long-standing freedom from external oversight and control has been cited as a cause of this incident, leading to outbursts in the political sphere on the 17th about the need for constitutional amendments and even dissolution-level reforms. Yet, given the constitutional spirit and historical context that guarantee the NEC’s independence, some argue that issues should be resolved through measures such as making the NEC chairperson a full-time position and establishing an independent audit body within the NEC, rather than amending the constitution. (중앙선거관리위원회는 4·19 혁명 도화선이 된 1960년 3·15 부정선거 이후 ‘관권선거’를 막자는 취지로 1963년 헌법상 독립기구로 설립된 뒤 한국 민주주의 발전에 기여해왔다. 그러나 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 ‘63년 선관위 체제’의 근본적인 수술이 필요하다는 목소리가 높아지고 있다. 중앙선관위가 그동안 외부 감시와 통제에서 벗어나 있던 것이 이번 사태의 원인으로 지목되며 17일 정치권에선 개헌 필요성과 더불어 해체 수준의 개혁이 필요하다는 주장이 분출한다. 다만 선관위의 독립성을 보장한 헌법 정신과 역사적 맥락을 고려하면 개헌보다 중앙선관위원장 상임화와 중앙선관위 내 독립 감사기구 설치 등을 통해 문제를 풀어야 한다는 주장도 있다.)

On the day of the local elections (the 3rd), the Songpa-gu Election Commission in Seoul recognized the ballot paper shortage around 11:40 a.m. that day and notified the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission, but the responsible staff member at the Seoul commission did not report it to the standing commissioner or the secretary general. It wasn’t until after 5 p.m. that same day that the severity of the situation was recognized, and a response was initiated jointly with the NEC. Citizens are questioning the very existence of the NEC, the 17 metropolitan and provincial election commissions, and the 255 municipal, county, and district election commissions, which have starkly revealed a structure that is powerless in crisis response and where no one takes responsibility. (지방선거 당일(3일) 서울 송파구 선관위는 투표용지 부족을 그날 오전 11시40분께 인지하고, 서울시 선관위에 알렸지만 서울시 선관위 담당 직원은 상임위원이나 사무처장에게 보고하지 않았다. 같은 날 오후 5시가 넘어서야 사태의 심각성을 인지하고 중앙선관위와 함께 대응에 나섰다. 국민들은 위기 대응에 무력하고 누구도 책임지지 않는 구조라는 걸 적나라하게 보여준 중앙선관위와 17개 시·도 선관위, 255개 시·군·구 선관위의 존재 의미를 묻고 있다.)

First, experts point out that the current structure, where eight of the nine NEC commissioners, including the chairperson, hold non-standing positions, needs to be changed. Chang Young-soo, a professor at Korea University Law School, noted, “The biggest reason the entire NEC has become an organization with lax discipline is that it has been operated like an ‘ownerless company.’” He added, “Could non-standing commissioners, who have their own primary jobs, have properly grasped the overall work of the NEC? The significance and depth of their decisions have weakened, and the overall management and supervision of the organization have become inadequate.” This suggests the need to expand the number of standing commissioners who can dedicate themselves to election management duties and take responsibility. (먼저 전문가들은 위원장 포함 9명의 선관위원 중 8명이 비상임직인 현행 구조를 바꿔야 한다고 지적한다. 장영수 고려대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “선관위 전체가 기강이 해이한 조직이 돼버린 가장 큰 이유는 ‘주인 없는 기업’처럼 운영됐다는 것”이라며 “본업이 있는 비상임 선관위원들이 선관위 전체 업무를 제대로 파악했겠느냐. 이들이 한 결정의 의미나 깊이가 약해지고 조직 전체의 관리·감독이 부실하게 됐다”고 지적했다. 선거 관리 업무에 전념하고 책임을 질 수 있는 상임위원 확대가 필요하다는 것이다.)

Making the NEC chairperson and metropolitan/provincial election commission chairpersons full-time positions is being discussed as an alternative. However, at a forum hosted on the 17th by the Democratic Party of Korea’s ‘Task Force for Electoral System Reform,’ Jeong Tae-ho, an emeritus professor at Kyung Hee University Law School, stated, “The key challenge is not whether to make the chairperson a full-time position, but how to strengthen the expertise and accountability of the secretariat.” He proposed, “How about appointing a secretary general or standing commissioner who can objectively examine the organization?” (중앙선관위원장과 시·도 선관위원장 상임화가 대안으로 거론된다. 다만 더불어민주당 ‘선거제도 개혁 태스크포스(TF)’가 17일 주최한 토론회에서 정태호 경희대 법학전문대학원 명예교수는 “위원장의 상임화 여부보다 사무처의 전문성과 책임성을 어떻게 강화할 것인가가 중요한 과제”라며 “객관적으로 (조직을) 들여다볼 수 있는 사람으로 사무총장이나 상임위원을 위촉하는 것은 어떻겠나”라고 제안했다.)

Currently, both the ruling and opposition parties argue that fundamental problem-solving requires institutional reforms to allow the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) to conduct performance audits on the NEC or enable external oversight. To this end, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party are raising the need for a constitutional amendment explicitly making the NEC—a constitutional institution independent from the executive, legislative, and judicial branches—subject to BAI audits. (현재 여야 모두 근본적인 문제 해결을 위해 중앙선관위도 감사원의 직무감찰을 받거나 외부 감시가 가능하도록 하는 제도적 개혁이 필요하다는 주장을 하고 있다. 이를 위해 민주당과 국민의힘은 헌법상 행정부, 입법부, 사법부로부터 독립된 헌법기관인 선관위를 감사원의 감사 대상으로 명시하는 개헌 필요성을 제기한다.)

Currently, the BAI can only conduct financial audits on the NEC, not performance audits. When the BAI attempted a performance audit in May 2023 over allegations of preferential hiring by the NEC, the NEC filed a competence dispute with the Constitutional Court, which ruled in February that the BAI’s audit was unconstitutional. The court determined that it had infringed on the NEC’s independence. The constitutional fence designed to prevent specific regimes or political forces from exerting influence, in order to block government-managed elections, has paradoxically become a ‘shield’ for the NEC. (현재 감사원은 중앙선관위에 대해 회계감사 외에 감사를 할 수 없다. 감사원이 2023년 5월 선관위의 채용 특혜 의혹에 직무감찰을 하자 선관위는 헌법재판소에 권한쟁의심판을 청구했는데, 헌재는 지난 2월 감사원의 감사가 위헌이라고 판단했다. ‘선관위의 독립성을 침해했다’는 판단이다. 관권 선거를 막기 위해 특정 정권, 정치세력이 영향을 끼칠 수 없도록 한 헌법의 울타리가 역설적으로 선관위의 ‘방패’가 된 것이다.)

However, there are considerable concerns that amending the constitution and shaking the NEC’s independence could leave it vulnerable to influence from the ruling government in the future. At the Democratic Party’s TF forum, Professor Jeong pointed out, “The BAI, being a constitutional institution under the president, leaves open the risk of being misused as a means to infringe on the NEC’s independence.” There is concern that if the ruling power affects the NEC through audit or personnel powers, the foundation of democracy could be shaken. In response, Professor Jeong suggested alternatives such as establishing an independent election management evaluation committee, institutionalizing regular reports to the National Assembly, reporting election incidents, and legislating obligations for preventing recurrence. Kim Kyu-beom, head of the NEC branch of the National Government Employees’ Union, told The Hankyoreh, “If we come under audit by the BAI, which is under the president, the NEC cannot be free from the president. Even if the NEC undergoes audits, such concerns must be resolved.” (그러나 개헌을 통해 선관위의 독립성을 흔들 경우 앞으로 정권의 입김에 휘둘릴 수 있다는 우려도 만만치 않게 나온다. 민주당 티에프 토론회에서 정 명예교수는 “감사원은 대통령 소속 헌법기관이라는 점에서 선관위의 독립성을 침해하는 수단으로 악용될 위험을 배제할 수 없다”고 지적했다. 집권세력이 감사권이나 인사권을 통해 선관위에 영향을 미칠 경우 민주주의의 근간이 흔들릴 수 있다는 우려다. 이에 정 명예교수는 독립적인 선거관리평가위 설치, 국회에 대한 정기 보고의 제도화, 선거 사고 보고, 재발 방지 의무 법제화 등을 대안으로 제시했다. 김규범 국가공무원노조 선관위지부 위원장은 한겨레에 “대통령 아래 있는 감사원의 감사를 받게 되면 대통령으로부터 선관위가 자유로울 수 없다. 선관위가 감사를 받더라도 이런 우려가 해소돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, there are strong voices calling for urgent improvements in election management capabilities and the electoral affairs model, alongside structural reforms. In particular, improving the NEC’s crisis response system, which has proven powerless in emergencies, is crucial. Lee Joon-han, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Incheon National University, told The Hankyoreh, “The NEC needs a system like a ‘five-minute standby team’ that can receive accurate reports and respond swiftly and orderly when unexpected incidents occur.” There are also proposals to introduce a method of printing ballot papers for regular voting, similar to early voting, to prevent a recurrence of the ballot paper shortage. (한편 구조개혁과 더불어 선거관리 역량 강화와 선거사무 모델 개선이 시급하다는 목소리도 크다. 특히 비상 상황에 무력한 선관위의 위기 대응 체계 개선도 중요하다. 이준한 인천대 정치외교학과 교수는 한겨레에 “돌발 상황이 생기면 정확한 보고를 받고 대처를 일사불란하게 할 수 있는 ‘5분 대기조’ 같은 체계가 선관위에 있어야 한다”고 했다. 투표용지 부족 재발을 막기 위해 본투표도 사전투표처럼 투표용지를 인쇄하는 방식을 도입해야 한다는 주장도 나온다.)

item.title: Noh Tae-ak, Overseas Trips with Wife…'Companion' Omitted (노태악, 아내와 선관위 해외 출장…‘동반 사실’ 누락)
item.description:
Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairman Noh Tae-ak was confirmed to have taken three overseas business trips accompanied by his spouse during his tenure. <<> According to documents submitted by the NEC to Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Yang Bu-nam on the 17th, former Chairman Noh brought his spouse on three overseas trips during his time in office. These included: an 8-night, 9-day trip to Australia and New Zealand in 2022; a 7-night, 9-day trip to Germany and Estonia in 2024; and an 8-night, 10-day trip to Denmark and Sweden in 2025. The airfare and accommodation costs for former Chairman Noh's spouse on these trips were all covered by taxpayer money. These three trips were official business trips aimed at gathering opinions on election and political systems, evaluating overseas elections, developing election systems, enhancing international networks, and fostering exchanges and cooperation with foreign election management bodies. <<> However, the NEC did not disclose the fact that the spouse accompanied the chairman in publicly released reports. The 2024 overseas trip plan for Germany and Estonia listed only five NEC employees, including former Chairman Noh, as travelers. Similarly, the 2025 trip plan for Denmark and Sweden also omitted the name of former Chairman Noh's spouse. This has raised suspicions that the NEC intentionally concealed the spouse's accompaniment to avoid criticism of budget waste. <<> Allegations of the trips being pleasure-oriented have also emerged. For example, the Denmark and Sweden trip was purportedly aimed at exploring ways to develop the election system by observing local foreign elections, but the schedule for the day after arrival consisted solely of laying flowers at a Korean War memorial. Critics also argue that the local officials former Chairman Noh—ranked 6th in the national protocol order—met with were only working-level staff, which was below his status. Lawmaker Yang criticized, "Neglecting core election management duties while arranging couple's trips under the guise of 'overseas institutional exchanges' is a clear case of pleasure-oriented privilege and a waste of taxpayers' hard-earned money." <<> The NEC explained, "As the head of a constitutional institution, it was necessary to consider treatment commensurate with the position and role, so the budget for the spouse was allocated from the planning stage," adding, "We followed precedent, but going forward, we will operate in line with public expectations." Regarding the omission of the spouse's name from the reports, the commission cited that she was not a public official. <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 재임 기간 동안 3차례 배우자와 동반 해외 출장을 다녀온 것으로 확인됐다.)

item.title: Legal Professionals: "Nationwide Re-run Election Lacks Requirements, Realistically Impossible" (법조인들 “전국 재선거론, 요건 미비 현실적 불가”)
item.description:
As Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, repeatedly advocates for a nationwide re-run election, political scholars and legal professionals point out that it is realistically impossible. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 연일 ‘전국 재선거론’을 주장하는 가운데 정치학자들과 법조인들은 현실적으로 불가능하다고 지적했다.)

Article 224 of the Public Official Election Act states, "Even if there is a violation of election-related regulations, invalidation of all or part of the election or invalidation of the election of a candidate shall be decided or adjudicated only when it is recognized that it affected the outcome of the election." In other words, a re-run election is possible only if it is acknowledged that the missing ballots could have changed the winner—meaning that if all voters who were unable to vote in the ballot paper shortage had voted, the winning candidate might have changed. (공직선거법 224조는 “선거에 관한 규정에 위반된 사실이 있는 때라도 선거의 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때에 한하여 선거의 전부나 일부의 무효 또는 당선의 무효를 결정하거나 판결한다”고 돼 있다. 투표용지 부족 사태 탓에 투표를 못 한 유권자가 모두 투표했을 때 당선자가 바뀔 가능성이 인정돼야 재선거가 가능하다는 것이다.)

However, in the June 3 local elections for the Seoul mayoral race, the vote gap between Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party and Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea was 60,259 votes. On the 9th, the National Election Commission disclosed in data submitted to Rep. Jeong Hee-yong of the People Power Party that the total number of missing ballot papers across Seoul was 4,206. The likelihood of the Seoul mayoral election result changing is thus extremely slim. However, proportional representation elections for metropolitan and basic council members with narrower vote margins could potentially be subject to a re-run election. (그런데 6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에서 오세훈 국민의힘 후보와 정원오 더불어민주당 후보의 득표 차는 6만259표였다. 중앙선거관리위원회는 지난 9일 정희용 국민의힘 의원에게 낸 자료에서 서울시 전체에서 부족했던 투표용지 수는 4206장이라고 밝혔다. 서울시장 선거 결과가 바뀔 가능성은 희박한 셈이다. 다만, 표 차이가 적은 광역·기초의원 비례대표 선거는 재선거가 결정될 가능성도 있다.)

Even if a re-run election were held, how to handle both regular voting and early voting also poses a problem. (재선거를 한다고 해도 본투표와 사전투표를 어떻게 할지도 문제다.)

If only the regular voting is re-conducted because the ballot shortage occurred solely during regular voting, the voter turnout might drop. Even if early voting is included, holding a re-run election in only certain areas would make it difficult for voters residing outside those areas to cast absentee early ballots, leading to issues of 'violation of voting rights.' Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, wrote on Facebook on the 16th, "It would be problematic if the solution brought up to address the violation of voting rights paradoxically reduces the total number of votes cast. Representative Jang's call for a full-scale re-run election cannot lead to a fair election, no matter which direction it takes." (본투표에서만 투표용지 부족 사태가 있었다고 해서 본투표만 다시 하면 투표율이 떨어질 수 있다. 사전투표까지 같이 시행한다고 해도, 일부 지역만 재선거를 하면 그 외 지역에 나가 있는 유권자는 관외 사전투표가 어려워져 ‘참정권 침해’ 문제가 발생한다. 이준석 개혁신당 대표는 지난 16일 페이스북에 “참정권 침해를 해결하기 위해 들고나오는 해법이 오히려 총 투표수가 줄어드는 역설이면 곤란하다”며 “장 대표의 전면적 재선거는 어느 쪽으로 가도 공정한 선거가 될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Choi Jang-jip, an emeritus professor at Korea University and a veteran political scholar, said to *The Hankyoreh*, "Even if some people had their voting rights infringed upon due to the ballot shortage, those who already voted followed proper procedures, and the results came out. It is problematic to ask these people to vote again." Kim Jun-woo, secretary-general of Lawyers for a Democratic Society, stated, "Even if the court decides on a re-run election, it would likely narrow the scope to only the affected polling stations for regular voting." (원로 정치학자인 최장집 고려대 명예교수는 한겨레에 “(투표용지 부족 사태로) 참정권이 침해된 사람이 있어도, 이미 투표했던 사람은 정당한 절차를 다 밟아서 투표해서 결과가 나왔다. 그런데 이런 사람들까지 다시 다 투표하라는 건 곤란하다”고 말했다. 민주사회를 위한 변호사모임 사무총장 김준우 변호사는 “법원이 만약 재선거를 결정하더라도 가장 범위를 좁혀서, 본투표에 한해 그 (문제가 발생한) 투표구에 한해서만 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Jang Dong-hyuk's mention on the 9th of "proposing a special law for conducting a re-run election" also carries constitutional concerns as it would be retroactive legislation. Article 13, Clause 2 of the Constitution stipulates, "All citizens shall not be restricted in their voting rights or deprived of property rights by retroactive legislation." If a re-run election changes the winner, it would result in infringing on the voting rights of the existing winner through retroactive legislation. It is also difficult to find 'fault attributable to the party involved,' which is an exceptional circumstance allowing retroactive legislation. (장동혁 대표가 지난 9일 언급한 “재선거 실시를 위한 특별법 발의”도 소급입법이라 위헌 소지가 있다. 헌법 제13조 제2항은 “모든 국민은 소급입법에 의하여 참정권의 제한을 받거나 재산권을 박탈당하지 아니한다”고 정한다. 재선거로 당선자가 뒤바뀔 경우 기존 당선자의 참정권을 소급입법으로 침해하는 결과를 낳는다. 소급입법 허용의 예외적 사정으로 인정되는 ‘당사자 귀책사유’를 찾기도 어렵다.)

Attorney Lim Jae-sung said to *The Hankyoreh*, "Just like in the past when property rights were deprived through retroactive legislation in the recovery of pro-Japanese assets, retroactive legislation is possible only when there is fault on the part of the party. Since the winners of this election are not at fault, it seems unlikely that the special law would be constitutional." Kim Jun-woo also stated, "Because people who have already exercised their voting rights would be harmed, the special law doesn't make sense." (임재성 변호사는 한겨레에 “과거 친일 재산 환수 때 소급입법으로 재산권을 박탈당한 사람들처럼, 당사자에게 귀책사유가 있어야 소급입법 가능성이 있다”며 “이번 선거 당선자들에게 잘못이 있는 게 아니어서 (특별법이 합헌일) 가능성이 없어 보인다”고 말했다. 김준우 변호사도 “이미 참정권을 행사한 사람들이 피해를 보기 때문에 (특별법은) 말이 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Loser" Resignation Calls Erupt Against Jang Dong-hyuk... People Power Party Files Reelection Appeals for 7 Regions (장동혁 향해 “찌질이” 사퇴론 분출…국힘, 7곳 재선거 소청)
item.description:
On the 17th, after a general meeting of lawmakers, the People Power Party filed election appeals with the National Election Commission and relevant election commissions for a total of 11 regions in connection with the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections. These included seven regions—Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, Jeonnam/Gwangju, and Chungbuk—filed under the party's name, and four regions—Daejeon, Sejong, Chungnam, and Jeonbuk—filed under the names of candidates. At the meeting, demands for Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation as party leader erupted, but no conclusion was reached. <<> The People Power Party made this decision regarding the election appeal issue during the general meeting that began around 2 p.m. and lasted over three hours. Rep. Jang argued, "Since we don't know which regions might face issues during the National Assembly's audit of the election commission, let's file election appeals with the central election commission for all 16 metropolitan governments." However, floor leader Rep. Chung Jin-suk reportedly insisted on filing appeals only for the seven regions—Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, Jeonnam/Gwangju, and Chungbuk—as initially decided by the supreme council meeting. Some lawmakers reportedly questioned, "We won the Seoul mayoral election, so why file an appeal?" After debating the issue for over two hours, the lawmakers decided through a show of hands to file appeals for seven regions. In the vote involving 50 participants, it is known that only two lawmakers—Rep. Park Jun-tae, the party leader's chief of staff, and Rep. Lee Jin-sook—voted in favor of filing appeals for all 16 regions nationwide. Rep. Jang left after staying for about an hour and a half. After the meeting, Rep. Park Jun-tae told *The Hankyoreh*, "We respect the decision of the general meeting, so we filed appeals for seven regions under the party's name and guided candidates to file for four regions on their own behalf." <<> An election appeal is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election or a candidate's victory to the election commission, which must make a decision within 60 days of receiving the appeal. If the election commission accepts the appeal, a reelection is held within 30 days of the decision notification. <<> At the general meeting, there was also heated debate over the issue of Rep. Jang's resignation. Rep. Song Seok-joon requested to make a public statement just before the meeting went into closed session but was blocked, prompting him to say, "There has never been a refusal to allow public statements. In the 22nd National Assembly, our party has completely fallen into a state of non-communication. Isn't that why we've ended up in this worst-case scenario?" Rep. Park Jun-tae shouted back, "If that's the case, go out and (hold a press conference) yourself." <<> During the closed-door meeting, lawmakers including Reps. Song Seok-joon, Kwon Young-jin, Yoon Han-hong, Shin Sung-beom, and Park Hyung-soo, who sat in the front row facing Rep. Jang, urged him to publicly resign. Rep. Song told reporters, "Losing important elections or wars requires boldly taking responsibility and stepping down; that's the essence of a responsible term-based system," adding, "I warned that if he doesn't resign, he won't escape being called a 'loser.'" Rep. Kwon also said, "Proposing a reelection alongside election fraud conspiracy theorists is not an attitude befitting a responsible party." Rep. Park Hyung-soo similarly remarked, "Rep. Jang is already a blunt spear. How can we use that to check President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party's dictatorship?" Rep. Kim Jeong-jae and others urged Rep. Jang not to advocate for a "full-scale reelection." <<> However, Reps. Lee Jin-sook and Kang Seung-gyu spoke against Rep. Jang's resignation. Rep. Park Jun-tae told reporters, "Is the party leader's departure more important than protecting the people's right to vote?" and targeted the party's young-lawmaker group "Alternatives and Future," which demanded Jang's resignation, saying, "If they don't disband, I'll rename them 'Future Without Alternatives.'" <<> Meanwhile, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, meeting with reporters before a hearing at the Seoul Central District Court on suspicions of illegal opinion poll cost payments, directly criticized, "The Jang Dong-hyuk leadership has run its course," adding, "The reelection claim is a tactical slogan to strengthen his own political position." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (국민의힘이 17일 의원총회 뒤 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 당 차원에서 서울·경기·인천·부산·울산·전남광주·충북 7곳, 후보자 명의로 대전·세종·충남·전북 4곳 등 총 11곳에 대해 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위에 선거소청 접수를 신청했다. 의총에서는 장동혁 대표를 향한 사퇴 요구가 빗발쳤으나 결론을 내지 못했다.)

item.title: President Lee Calls on Trump to Be "Peacemaker" for Korean Peninsula… Trump Responds "I Will" (이 대통령 “한반도 피스메이커” 요청…트럼프 “하겠다” 화답)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a visit to Europe, requested U.S. President Donald Trump on the 16th (local time) to "play a constructive role as a peacemaker for the substantive resolution of issues on the Korean Peninsula." In response, President Trump said, "I will fulfill the necessary role." <<> During an official dinner hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) summit in Évian-les-Bains, President Lee met with President Donald Trump and stated, "We hope for continued attention and engagement to establish sustainable peace on the Korean Peninsula, following the Middle East," according to Deputy National Security Advisor Oh Hyun-joo on the 17th. In response, President Trump expressed a strong commitment, saying, "I will do what is necessary to advance the Korean Peninsula issue," and added, "I will explore ways to contribute to peace on the Korean Peninsula and will communicate closely with President Lee," Deputy Advisor Oh reported. <<> Deputy Advisor Oh added, "President Trump assessed President Lee as a 'strong leader,' and both leaders expressed expectations that they could jointly contribute to peace and security on the Korean Peninsula." She also noted, "The two leaders agreed on the importance of South Korea-U.S.-Japan cooperation, based on a robust South Korea-U.S. alliance." President Lee sat next to President Trump at the official dinner and conversed for about two hours. <<> The South Korean and U.S. leaders also exchanged views on the U.S.-Israel vs. Iran war, which is approaching a ceasefire phase. <<> Deputy Advisor Oh said, "The two leaders concurred on the importance of free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," and added, "They shared expectations that the restoration of stability and peace in the Middle East would stabilize oil prices and lead to economic recovery." It was reported that President Lee conveyed his congratulations on the successful conclusion of the U.S.-Iran ceasefire negotiations, particularly on President Trump's birthday. <<> Discussions also touched on the "Iran reconstruction fund." The U.S. financial daily *Financial Times* reported on the 15th that the U.S. is considering creating a $300 billion (approximately 454 trillion won) fund for Iran's reconstruction. A key official from the presidential office stated, "President Lee expressed that South Korea has the will and capability to substantially contribute to the efforts of the entire international community, including the U.S., to ensure free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz in the future." <<> On the same day, President Lee also engaged in defense sales during a summit with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. He told Prime Minister Carney, "South Korea, as a defense powerhouse, is ready to actively contribute to strengthening Canada's security capabilities based on trust." South Korea's Hanwha Ocean is competing with Germany's Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) for a contract in Canada's next-generation submarine project, valued at up to 60 trillion won. On the 17th, before the start of the second session of the expanded G7 summit meeting, President Lee held a brief 10-minute meeting with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. President Lee will conclude his European tour with a South Korea-Kenya summit and a working luncheon of the summit meeting, returning home on the 18th. <<> Évian-les-Bains / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (유럽을 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게 “한반도 문제의 실질적 해결을 위해 피스메이커로서 건설적 역할을 해달라”고 요청했다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “필요한 역할을 다하겠다”고 답했다.)

item.title: Foreign Election Commissions Under Parliamentary/Government Control… Monitoring Structures Despite Independence Guarantees (외국 선관위 의회·정부 통제 받아…독립성 보장에도 감시구조 갖춰)
item.description:
South Korea’s National Election Commission is explicitly defined as an independent body under the Constitution, ensuring high independence, but it effectively lacks parliamentary oversight or external audits. In contrast, most foreign election management bodies guarantee independence while maintaining structures where parliaments or external audit agencies monitor and control budgets, personnel, and performance. (한국의 선거관리위원회는 헌법상 독립기구로 명시된 만큼 독립성이 높지만, 의회 감독이나 외부 감사가 사실상 없다. 반면 국외 선거관리기관은 독립성을 보장하되, 의회나 외부 감사기구가 예산·인사·성과 등을 감시·통제하는 구조를 갖춘 경우가 대부분이다.)

According to the International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (International IDEA)’s “Comparative Report on Election Management Bodies by Country” (2014) and the National Election Commission’s “2024 Comparative Study of Election Management Bodies in Various Countries,” election management bodies are broadly classified into three types: independent, governmental (where a body under the executive branch manages elections), and mixed (where an independent body and an executive body jointly manage elections). Independent types include South Korea, Australia, and Canada; governmental types include Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States; and mixed types include France and Japan. ( 17일 국제민주주의선거지원연구소(International IDEA)의 ‘국가별 선거관리기관 비교 보고서’(2014), 중앙선거관리위원회의 ‘2024년도 각국의 선거관리기관 비교연구’ 보고서를 보면, 선거관리기관은 크게 독립형, 행정부형(행정부 소속 기구가 선거 관리), 혼합형(독립기구와 행정부 기구가 함께 선거 관리)으로 나뉜다. 독립형은 한국·오스트레일리아(호주)·캐나다, 행정부형은 독일·영국·미국, 혼합형은 프랑스·일본 등이다.)

Most countries, regardless of the status of their election management bodies, have external monitoring structures. Election management bodies in independent-type countries such as India, South Africa, and Kenya are constitutional independent bodies with very high independence and legal status, but they still undergo parliamentary oversight or audits by audit institutions. ( 대부분의 국가는 선거관리기구의 위상과 상관없이 외부 감시 구조를 갖추고 있다. 독립형인 인도, 남아프리카공화국, 케냐 등의 선거관리기관은 헌법상 독립기구로 독립성과 법적 지위가 매우 높지만 의회 감독이나 감사원 감사 등을 받는다.)

Governmental and mixed-type election management bodies face strong control from parliaments and governments. In the United Kingdom, a committee chaired by the Speaker of the House of Commons reviews the election commission’s budget proposal and five-year plan. It also undergoes financial and performance audits by the National Audit Office (NAO) under Parliament. In Germany, the head of the Federal Statistical Office concurrently serves as the Federal Returning Officer, subject to financial audits by the Federal Court of Auditors, with an obligation to report on whether issues noted during audits have been corrected. In France, the Ministry of the Interior directly handles election administration, and like other administrative bodies, it undergoes financial and performance audits by the Court of Audit. ( 행정부형·혼합형 선거관리기관은 의회와 정부의 강한 통제를 받는다. 영국은 하원 의장이 주재하는 위원회가 선관위 예산안과 5개년 계획을 심사한다. 의회 소속 국가감사원(NAO)으로부터 재무 감사와 성과 감사도 받는다. 독일은 통계청장이 연방선거관리관을 겸임하는데 연방감사원 재정 감사를 받고, 감사 당시 지적 사항을 시정했는지 보고할 의무가 있다. 프랑스는 내무부가 직접 선거행정을 담당해 다른 행정기관과 마찬가지로 회계감사원으로부터 재무 감사와 성과 감사를 받는다.)

Meanwhile, unlike South Korea, where the chairman of the National Election Commission is a non-standing position, in most countries such as Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom, the head of the election management body holds a standing position. ( 한편, 선거관리위원장이 비상임직인 우리와 달리 캐나다, 오스트레일리아, 영국 등 대부분의 국가는 선거관리기관장이 상임직이다.)

Reporter Goh Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr ( 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on Jeong Yi-han's alleged 'self-staged attack and concussion': "Apology... cooperating with investigation" (이준석, 정이한 ‘피습 뇌진탕 자작극’ 의혹에 “사과…수사 협조”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, said on the 17th regarding suspicions of a 'self-staged attack' by Jeong Yi-han, a former candidate who ran in the June 3 Busan mayoral election, "We will operate a party fact-finding team and strictly hold former candidate Jeong to the highest level of civil and criminal responsibility based on the facts that emerge." (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 6·3부산시장 선거에 출마했던 정이한 후보의 ‘피습 자작극’ 의혹에 대해 “당 자체 진상조사단을 가동해 드러나는 사실관계에 따라 정 전 후보에게 최고 강도의 민·형사상 책임을 엄정히 묻겠다”고 17일 말했다.)

On Facebook that day, Representative Lee wrote, "Since he was a candidate nominated by the Reform Party, we feel an infinite sense of responsibility for this matter," adding, "I once again bow my head in apology to the citizens of Busan who have been hurt by this incident, and to all those who supported the Reform Party in good faith." (이 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “개혁신당이 공천한 후보였기에, 저희는 이 사안에 대해 무한한 책임감을 느낀다”며 “이 사건으로 마음에 상처를 입으신 부산 시민 여러분, 그리고 선의로 개혁신당을 지지해주신 모든 분들께 다시 한번 머리 숙여 사과드린다”고 썼다.)

Representative Lee stated, "If the information disclosed by investigative authorities and reported by the media is true, this is a grave election crime that is difficult even to imagine," and "The Reform Party will actively cooperate with all procedures of the investigative authorities to ensure not a single shred of doubt remains." (이 대표는 “수사기관이 공개하고 언론이 보도한 내용이 사실이라면, 이는 상상하기조차 어려운 중대한 선거범죄”라며 “개혁신당은 한 치의 의혹도 남지 않도록 수사기관의 모든 절차에 적극적으로 협조하겠다”고 했다.)

Previously, former candidate Jeong publicly revealed on April 27 that while campaigning near Gu-seo Interchange in Geumjeong-gu, Busan, he was hit by a drink thrown out of a car window by a man from a passing vehicle. At the time, his campaign announced that Jeong fainted while trying to dodge the drink, was taken to the hospital, and was diagnosed with a concussion and bruises. Police are investigating the possibility that the incident was a self-staged act, and former candidate Jeong withdrew from the party using the party's online system. (앞서, 정 전 후보는 지난 4월27일 부산 금정구 구서나들목 인근에서 선거운동을 하던 중 지나가던 승용차에서 남성이 차창 밖으로 던진 음료에 맞았다고 언론에 공개했다. 당시 캠프는 정 전 후보가 음료를 피하려다 넘어져 의식을 잃고 병원으로 옮겨졌으며 뇌진탕과 근좌상 진단을 받았다고 밝혔다. 경찰은 이 사건과 관련해 자작극 가능성을 수사 중이고, 정 전 후보는 당 온라인시스템을 이용해 탈당했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Gyeonggi lawmakers of the People Power Party cancel press conference demanding 'Chang Dong-hyuk's resignation' one hour prior (‘장동혁 사퇴 촉구’ 회견 1시간 전에 취소한 국힘 경기 의원들)
item.description:
Lawmakers from Gyeonggi Province belonging to the People Power Party (PPP) announced and then canceled a press conference on the 18th demanding the resignation of party leader Chang Dong-hyuk. (국민의힘 소속 경기 지역 의원들이 18일 장동혁 대표 사퇴를 촉구하는 기자회견을 예고했다가 취소했다. )

PPP lawmakers with constituencies in Gyeonggi Province were scheduled to hold a press conference at 1:30 p.m. that day at the National Assembly Communication Center to call for Chang's resignation, but around noon they stated the press conference would be canceled. (경기도에 지역구를 둔 국민의힘 의원들은 이날 오후 1시30분 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열고 장 대표 사퇴를 촉구할 예정이었으나, 이날 낮 12시께 회견을 취소한다고 밝혔다. )

They had planned to issue a statement that the public sentiment in the Seoul metropolitan area, as confirmed by the results of the June 3 local elections, requires a change in the party leadership's course, and that Chang should step down for this purpose. Initially, it was reported that among the PPP lawmakers in Gyeonggi Province, excluding lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, the names of Kim Sun-kyo, Kim Sung-won, Song Seok-joon, Kim Eun-hye, Kim Yong-tae, and Yoo Eui-dong were to be included in the press release. However, as some lawmakers expressed reservations, the press conference itself appears to have fallen through. ( 이들은 6·3 지방선거 결과에서 확인된 수도권 민심은 당 지도부의 노선 변화라며, 이를 위해 장 대표가 물러나야 한다는 입장을 낼 예정이었다. 애초 기자회견문에는 경기 지역 국민의힘 의원 가운데 안철수 의원을 제외한 김선교·김성원·송석준·김은혜·김용태·유의동 의원이 이름을 올리기로 알려졌는데, 일부 의원이 보류 의사를 밝히면서 기자회견 자체가 무산된 것으로 보인다. )

The PPP will hold a general meeting of lawmakers at 1:40 p.m. that day at the National Assembly. This is a session to discuss the agenda items to be submitted to the plenary session at 2 p.m., and attention is focused on whether internal voices regarding Chang's status will erupt there as well. ( 국민의힘은 이날 오후 1시40분 국회에서 의원총회를 연다. 오후 2시 본회의에 상정하는 안건에 대해 논의하기 위한 자리인데 여기에서도 장 대표 거취에 대한 당내 목소리가 분출될 것인지에 눈길이 쏠린다.)

Earlier, at the PPP's general meeting of lawmakers the previous day, remarks calling for Chang's resignation had already emerged. Lawmaker Song Seok-joon, speaking with reporters after the general meeting, said, "The election, which should have been a judgment on the Lee Jae-myung administration, ended up being a judgment on Chang Dong-hyuk, who failed to adopt the proper party course," and added, "In the spirit of a responsible fixed term, if you lose a major election, you should step down and take responsibility, so I recommended Chang's resignation." ( 앞서 전날 국민의힘 의원총회에서도 장 대표 사퇴 촉구 발언이 나온 바 있다. 송석준 의원은 의총 뒤 기자들과 만나 “이재명 정부에 대한 심판이 돼야 할 선거가 오히려 제대로 된 당의 노선을 취하지 않은 장 대표에 대한 심판이 되고 말았다”며 “중요 선거에서 패하면 책임지고 물러나는 것이 책임형 임기제라는 의미에서 장 대표에게 사퇴를 권유했다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee returns home... Jung Cheong-rae greets him with a '90-degree bow' (이 대통령 귀국…정청래 ‘90도 인사’로 맞이)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung returned home on the 18th after concluding his first European tour, an 8-night, 10-day trip. (이재명 대통령이 8박10일간 첫 유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 귀국했다.)

The President arrived at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, at 11:34 a.m. that day. Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, attended and bowed to President Lee at nearly a 90-degree angle. President Lee told Leader Jung, "You did a good job." Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, known to be running in the upcoming Democratic Party convention in August, also attended alongside. Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader; Kang Hoon-sik, the presidential chief of staff; and Hong Ik-pyo, the senior presidential secretary for political affairs, were also present. ( 이 대통령은 이날 오전 11시34분 경기 성남 서울공항에 도착했다. 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 참석해 이 대통령에게 90도 가까이 허리를 굽혀 인사했다. 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했다”고 말했다. 오는 8월 민주당 전당대회에 출마할 것으로 알려진 김민석 국무총리도 나란히 참석했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표와 강훈식 대통령비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석 등도 자리했다.)

Previously, on the 9th, Leader Jung had not seen President Lee off on his departure overseas, which led to various interpretations. The Blue House explained at the time, "Considering the domestic situation, such as the prolonged Middle East war and poor management by the National Election Commission, we minimized the number of people from the Blue House and cabinet seeing him off." ( 앞서 정 대표는 지난 9일 이 대통령의 출국길에 배웅하지 않아 이를 두고 여러 해석이 나왔다. 청와대는 당시 “중동 전쟁의 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등 국내 상황을 고려해 청와대와 내각 인사 등 환송 인원을 최소화했다”고 설명했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Trump proposed a couple's golf game… received a signing pen as a gift" (이 대통령 “트럼프, 부부 동반 골프 제안…서명용 펜 선물받아”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 17th (local time) that he had secured a promise to play golf with U.S. President Donald Trump, saying, "The South Korea-U.S. relationship is solid and eternal." (이재명 대통령이 17일(현지시각) 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 골프를 함께하기로 약속받았다며 “한미관계는 단단하고 영원하다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee shared this in a post on X (formerly Twitter) after boarding the return flight following a 9-night, 10-day European tour. He said, "During dinner yesterday, we talked about golf, and he said he would golf with my wife and me, so my wife made him pinky-promise. Then today, as we parted after lunch, he again insisted we must definitely golf together. I thought it was just a passing remark, but now I think I need to prepare. item.title: [Exclusive] 'Ballot shortage' also occurred in last year's presidential election, the most recent local elections... "Not reported internally at the Election Commission" ([단독] ‘투표지 부족’ 지난해 대선·직전 지선 때도 있었다…“선관위 내부 보고 안 돼”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC), which continues to face controversy due to ballot shortages in the June 3 local elections, has been found to have used additional ballots at some polling stations during the local elections four years ago and last year's presidential election. Although there were previous instances of ballot shortages, the NEC lowered the minimum threshold for printing ballots from the existing 60% to 50% ahead of this election. The NEC also demonstrated a lax grasp of the situation, reporting at the second meeting of the Democratic Party's "Citizen Suffrage Protection Task Force (TF)" on the 16th that "there were no previous ballot shortages." (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 논란이 계속되고 있는 중앙선거관리위원회가 4년 전 지방선거와 지난해 대통령 선거에서도 일부 투표소에서 추가 투표용지를 사용했던 것으로 확인됐다. 이전 선거에서도 투표용지 부족 사례가 있었지만 중앙선관위는 이번 선거를 앞두고 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준을 기존 60%에서 50%로 하향했다. 중앙선관위는 지난 16일 더불어민주당 ‘국민참정권 수호 티에프(TF)’ 2차 회의에서 “이전에는 투표용지 부족이 없었다”고 보고하는 등 실태 파악도 허술했다.)

According to data obtained by Democratic Party lawmaker Lim Mi-ae from the NEC on the 18th, during the 8th local elections four years ago, 100 to 200 additional ballots were supplied to two polling stations. In one polling station in Goheung County, South Jeolla Province, one of the additionally distributed ballots was actually used. Additional ballots were also sent to one polling station during the 22nd general election held in 2024. Furthermore, in last year's 21st presidential election, additional ballots ranging from as few as 50 to as many as 500 were sent to 42 polling stations. Among these, 12 of the additionally distributed ballots were actually used at one polling station in Dalseong County, Daegu. It was found that in these three previous elections, there were no instances of voters waiting for ballots or voting being interrupted. The minimum threshold for printing ballots was 60% for the 8th local elections and 70% for the 22nd general election and 21st presidential election. (18일 임미애 민주당 의원이 중앙선관위로부터 받은 자료를 보면, 4년 전 제8회 지방선거 때도 투표소 총 2곳에 100∼200장의 추가 투표용지가 투입됐다. 이 중 전남 고흥군 한 투표소에선 추가배부 투표용지 1장이 실제로 사용됐다. 2024년 열린 22대 총선에서도 투표소 1곳에 추가 투표용지가 보내졌다. 또 지난해 21대 대선에선 투표소 42곳에 적게는 50장에서 많게는 500장의 투표용지가 추가로 보내졌다. 이 중 대구 달성군 한 투표소는 추가 배부된 투표용지 12장이 실제로 사용됐다. 다만 앞선 세 번의 선거에서는 선거인이 투표용지를 기다리며 대기하거나 투표가 중단된 사례는 없었던 것으로 파악됐다. 8회 지선의 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준은 60%, 22대 총선·21대 대선은 70%였다.)

Despite previous ballot shortage cases, the NEC lowered the minimum threshold for printing ballots from 60% to 50% through the decision of the Secretary-General ahead of this election. It has also been revealed that the NEC did not prepare a response manual or crisis response system for ballot shortage situations during this local election. Lawmaker Lim pointed out, "As ballot shortages can occur at any time, the NEC needs to be vigilant and establish a precise response manual." (이전 선거에서도 투표용지 부족 사례가 있었음에도 중앙선관위가 이번 선거를 앞두고 사무총장 전결로 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준을 기존 60%에서 50%로 낮췄다. 또 이번 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족 상황 발생 시 대처 매뉴얼과 위기 대응 체계도 준비하지 않은 것으로 드러났다. 임 의원은 “투표용지 부족은 언제든 일어날 수 있는 일인 만큼 선관위는 이에 대한 경각심을 갖고 대응 매뉴얼을 정확히 마련할 필요가 있다”고 지적했다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC, during its report on the ballot shortage situation at the second Democratic Party TF meeting on the 16th, stated that "no polling districts with ballot shortages in previous elections were confirmed or reported," indicating a poor grasp of the actual situation. Lawmaker Lim stated, "When the NEC reported to the Democratic Party TF, it stated that there were no previous ballot shortages, but that was not the case. The fact that, even if it didn't lead to voting interruptions, there were ballot shortages, and no internal reports were made at the NEC on how they were addressed, shows how complacent an organization the NEC is." (한편, 중앙선관위는 지난 16일 민주당 티에프 2차 회의에 투표용지 부족 사태 현황 보고를 하며 “이전 선거에서 투표용지가 부족했던 투표구는 확인·보고된 사실이 없었다”고 보고해 실태 파악도 허술했던 것으로 나타났다. 임 의원은 “선관위는 민주당 티에프 보고 때 이전에는 투표용지 부족 사태가 없었다고 답변했지만 실상은 그렇지 않았다”라며 “투표 중단 사태에 이르지 않았더라도 투표용지가 부족했고 어떻게 대응했는지 선관위 내부에서 전혀 보고가 이뤄지지 않은 것은 선관위가 얼마나 안일한 조직인지를 보여주는 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "North Korean regime, our enemy" phrase from Yoon Suk Yeol era... Defense Ministry says "maintain," Unification Ministry says "must change" (윤석열 때 쓴 “북 정권, 우리의 적”…국방부 “유지” 통일부 “바꿔야”)
item.description:
On the 18th, the Ministry of National Defense issued a statement regarding media reports that the phrase "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies," currently used in the '2026 Defense White Paper' slated for publication later this year, could be changed, asserting that "there is no change in the position that the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies." (올해 말 발간 예정인 ‘2026 국방백서’에서 기존의 ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현이 바뀔 수 있다는 언론 보도에 대해 국방부가 “북한 정권과 북한군이 우리의 적이라는 입장에 변함이 없다”는 입장을 18일 냈다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Lee Kyung-ho stated this at the regular defense ministry briefing, saying, "The defense white paper for this year is currently in the process of drafting, and we are reviewing the direction for its composition." This indicates an intention to retain the phrase "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies," which was explicitly stated in the '2022 Defense White Paper' published under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. (이경호 부대변인은 이날 국방부 정례브리핑에서 “올해 국방백서는 현재 초안을 마련 중이고, 작성 방향을 검토하고 있다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현은 윤석열 정부 때 펴낸 ‘2022 국방백서 2022’에 명시됐는데, 이를 유지하겠다는 취지다.)

However, the Ministry of Unification expressed a differing opinion on this matter, stating during the inter-agency consultation process for the defense white paper that the phrase needs to be changed. A Unification Ministry official told reporters on the same day, "Peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula is the firm policy goal of the Lee Jae-myung administration. We cannot pursue peaceful coexistence with a principal enemy while designating North Korea as such," adding, "The concept of the 'principal enemy' should be discussed as an extension of the former Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations, and the defense white paper also needs to be reviewed in this context." (그러나 통일부는 이에 대해 이견을 드러내며, 국방백서에 대한 부처 의견 수렴 과정에서 해당 표현의 변경이 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 통일부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “한반도 평화공존은 이재명 정부의 확고한 정책 목표로, 북한을 주적으로 규정하는 상태에서 주적인 북한과 평화공존을 추구할 순 없다”며 “주적 개념은 과거 노무현·문재인 정부의 연장선상에서 논의돼야 하고, 국방백서도 이런 맥락에서 검토될 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Since the defense white paper contains the government's defense policy stance, there has been keen interest in how North Korea will be defined in the '2026 Defense White Paper,' the first to be published under the Lee Jae-myung administration. As the Lee Jae-myung administration proposed "peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula" as its new North Korea policy, there were prospects that hostile expressions towards the North might be softened. However, with the continuing stalemate in inter-Korean relations, the Defense Ministry appears to be maintaining the previous administration's stance of designating the North Korean regime and military as the enemy. (국방백서는 정부 국방정책 기조를 담고 있기 때문에, 이재명 정부 들어 처음 발간되는 ‘2026 국방백서’에선 북한을 어떻게 규정할지 관심이 모였다. 이재명 정부가 ‘한반도 평화공존’을 새 대북정책으로 제시하면서, 북에 대한 적대적 표현이 완화될 수 있다는 전망도 나왔다. 그러나 남북 관계 경색이 계속되면서 국방부도 북한 정권과 북한군을 적으로 규정한 지난 정부 기조를 이어가고 있는 셈이다.)

The '2022 Defense White Paper,' published in 2023, stated for the first time in about six years that "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military, which have explicitly designated the Republic of Korea as an enemy and continue to pose military threats including nuclear weapons, are our enemies." The Yoon Suk Yeol administration intended to also publish a '2024 Defense White Paper' but failed to do so due to the fallout from the December 3 martial law declaration. (2023년 발간된 ‘2022 국방백서’는 6년여 만에 ‘대한민국을 명백한 적으로 규정하고 핵을 비롯한 군사 위협을 지속 가해오는 북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이라고 명시했다. 윤석열 정부는 ‘2024 국방백서’도 펴내려 했지만, 12·3비상계엄 여파로 발간하지 못했다.)

The debate over whether North Korea should be designated as an enemy or principal enemy has persisted for a long time. The expression 'principal enemy' was first used in the 1995 defense white paper under the Kim Young-sam administration, following North Korea's 'turn Seoul into a sea of fire' remarks in 1994. This term was used in defense white papers published until 2000. Then, starting with the 2004 defense white paper under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, it was replaced with phrases like 'direct military threat' and 'existing North Korean military threat.' Subsequently, in the '2008 Defense White Paper,' the first under the Lee Myung-bak administration, North Korea was described as a 'direct and serious threat.' The expression 'the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies' first appeared in the 2010 defense white paper following the Cheonan sinking incident. The Park Geun-hye administration also maintained this expression. (북한을 적 또는 주적으로 규정해야 하는지를 둘러싼 논쟁은 오랜 시간 이어졌다. ‘주적’ 표현은 1994년 북한의 ‘서울 불바다’ 발언을 계기로 김영삼 정부 때인 1995년 국방백서에 처음 사용됐다. 이후 2000년까지 발간된 국방백서에서 주적 표현이 쓰이다가, 노무현 정부 때인 2004년 국방백서부터 ‘직접적 군사위협’, ‘현존하는 북한의 군사적 위협’ 등으로 대체했다. 그 뒤 이명박 정부 첫 국방백서인 ‘2008 국방백서’엔 북은 ‘직접적이고 심각한 위협’으로 표현됐고, 천안함 사건이 발생한 2010년 국방백서에 ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현이 처음 등장했다. 박근혜 정부도 이렇게 표현했다.)

In contrast, the defense white papers of 2018 and 2020 under the Moon Jae-in administration did not specifically designate North Korea as the enemy, instead using the phrase: "We consider any forces that threaten and infringe upon our sovereignty, territory, people, and property as our enemies." Citing the examples of the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations' defense white papers, which did not single out North Korea as the enemy, the Unification Ministry maintains that the Lee Jae-myung administration's defense white paper should also review related expressions in this context. (반면, 문재인 정부 때인 2018년과 2010년 국방백서에선 적을 북한으로 특정하지 않고, ‘주권, 국토, 국민, 재산을 위협하고 침해하는 세력을 우리의 적으로 간주한다’는 표현을 썼다. 통일부는 북한을 적으로 지목하지 않았던 노무현·문재인 정부 국방백서 사례를 들며, 이재명 정부 국방백서도 이런 맥락에서 관련 표현을 검토해야 한다는 입장이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk hospitalized under 'resignation pressure'... "Overwork from fast, campaigns, and election commission crisis" (‘사퇴 압박’ 장동혁 입원…“단식·선거 이어 선관위 사태로 과로”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, visited the hospital emergency room on the 18th due to overwork and was admitted upon medical staff's recommendation. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 18일 과로로 인해 병원 응급실을 찾았다가 의료진의 권유로 입원했다.)

A party leadership official said, "Rep. Jang has accumulated fatigue from fasting, followed by local election campaign tours, and on-site responses to the National Election Commission crisis, leading to his hospitalization." (당 지도부 관계자는 “장 대표가 단식 이후 지방선거 지역 유세, 중앙선거관리위원회 사태 현장 대응 등으로 피로가 누적돼 입원했다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Jang had fasted for eight days in January, demanding 'dual special counsel investigations' into the 'Unification Church gate and allegations of bribery for Democratic Party nominations.' On the day of the June 3 local elections, when a shortage of ballot papers occurred, he visited the National Election Commission and the Seoul Election Commission overnight, and later shuttled between protest sites blocking vote counting stations at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul. (장 대표는 지난 1월 ‘통일교 게이트·더불어민주당 공천 헌금 의혹'에 대한 ‘쌍특검’을 요구하며 8일 동안 단식했다. 6·3 지방선거 본투표 당일에는 투표 용지 부족 사태가 벌어지자 밤새 중앙선관위와 서울선관위 등을 찾았고, 이후 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 개표소 봉쇄 시위 현장을 오갔다.)

item.title: National Assembly Passes Resolution for Parliamentary Investigation into 'Ballot Shortage Incident'...45 Days Until August 1 (국회, ‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 국정조사 의결…8월1일까지 45일간)
item.description:
On the 18th, the National Assembly's plenary session passed a plan for a parliamentary investigation to uncover the truth behind the ballot shortage incident during the local elections held on the 3rd and to reform election management. (지난 3일 치러진 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명과 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 계획서가 18일 국회 본회의를 통과했다.)

At the plenary session that day, the National Assembly, with 250 votes in favor and 1 against out of 251 attending members, approved the "Parliamentary Investigation Plan for Uncovering the Truth of the Infringement of Citizens' Suffrage Rights, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and for Election Management Reform." Independent lawmaker Choi Hyuk-jin expressed his opposition. (국회는 이날 본회의를 열어 재석 의원 251명 중 찬성 250명, 반대 1명으로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사계획서’를 의결했다. 최혁진 무소속 의원이 반대 의사를 밝혔다.)

The parliamentary investigation will be conducted for 45 days from today until August 1. The target institutions are the National Election Commission and all levels of election commissions. If an extension of activities is necessary, it can be approved through a vote in the plenary session. item.title: Voting Records Reveal Chaos…"Borrowed 400 Ballots from Next Booth" "Unable to Contact Election Commission" (혼란상 담긴 투표록 보니…“옆 투표소서 400매 빌림” “선관위 연락 불가”)
item.description:
'Requested guidance at 15:51 after ballots were depleted, but received no response; was told a call would be made, but no contact followed.' 'All ballots exhausted at 16:35. Voting suspended after informing voters and observers.' (Voting record Songpa-gu Jamsil 2-dong, 6th polling station) (‘15:51 투표용지가 소진된 후 지침을 달라 요청했으나 답변받지 못했고 전화 다시 준다고 했으나 연락이 없음’, ‘16:35 투표용지 전량 소진. 선거인, 참관인께 안내 후 투표 중단함’(송파구 잠실2동 제6투표소 투표록))

Voting records detailing the situation at polling stations hit by ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections have been released. The records provide a minute-by-minute account of the confusion on the ground, expected to serve as key evidence in uncovering the truth behind the ballot shortage crisis. ( 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 투표소의 당시 상황이 기록된 ‘투표록’이 공개됐다. 투표소 현장에서 시간대별로 벌어진 혼란이 상세히 기록돼있어 투표용지 부족 사태 진상 규명에 핵심 근거가 될 전망이다.)

The voting records of 439 polling stations in Seoul's Songpa, Gangnam, Gwangjin, Dongjak, and Seocho districts—submitted by the National Election Commission to Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, a member of the Special Committee for Parliamentary Investigation into the Election Commission, and released on the 18th—capture the turmoil experienced by election officials and voters during the subsequent processes of extending voting hours, distributing waiting tickets, and transporting additional ballots. In Songpa, where the chaos was most severe, records from 52 polling stations were released, excluding those unavailable due to the blockade of Olympic Park. <<> At the Jamsil 2-dong, 6th polling station in Songpa-gu, where the ballot shortage was first reported, the 'special remarks' section of the voting record shows the first entry at 2:53 PM: 'Notified the dong that 238 ballots remain; requested additional supply.' Subsequently, three calls were made to the election commission between 3:10 and 3:40 PM, but no follow-up action was taken, and all ballots were exhausted by 4:35 PM. About one hour and 20 minutes later, at 5:59 PM, it was noted: 'Delivered 50 ballots without serial numbers.' After the ballots arrived, errors in manual entries on the supplementary ballots, such as missing stamps, occurred, and the handwriting shifted from neat script to illegible scrawl. <<> The situation was similar at the Jamsil 7-dong, 2nd polling station. The record states that at 3:30 PM, it was realized only 220 ballots remained; at 3:45 PM, an additional 200 were requested; and at 4:46 PM, voting was temporarily suspended, and waiting tickets were issued and explained to voters waiting in line. Starting at 5:39 PM, supplementary ballots were received, and serial numbers were entered manually. Details such as how many times and what content was broadcast via announcements at locations like Jamsil Woosung Apartment until 10 PM were also recorded. The number of people who received tickets but had not arrived by 8:35 PM was noted as 17, with visible corrections in the figure. <<> Elsewhere, records reveal various scenarios: 'Informed voters of ballot shortage and need to wait; some gave up and left due to lack of time' (Guui 3-dong, 3rd polling station), 'Borrowed 400 ballots from Garak 2-dong, 2nd polling station' (Garak 2-dong, 3rd polling station), and 'Informed of 100 ballots, but due to prolonged delay, resumed voting without verifying total count' (Jamsil 2-dong, 2nd polling station). These encompass instances of issuing ballots without serial numbers, borrowing ballots between stations, and voters abandoning voting or filing complaints. <<> Meanwhile, it has been revealed that the National Election Commission also used supplementary ballots at some polling stations during the local elections four years ago and last year's presidential election. According to data received by Rep. Im Mi-ae of the Democratic Party from the National Election Commission, during the 8th local elections four years ago, an additional 100 to 200 ballots were supplied to two polling stations. In the 22nd general election in 2024, supplementary ballots were sent to one polling station, and in last year's 21st presidential election, additional ballots—ranging from as few as 50 to as many as 500—were dispatched to 42 polling stations. However, it has been confirmed that there were no instances of voters waiting for ballots or voting being suspended in the three prior elections. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ( ‘선관위 국정조사 특별위원회’ 소속 주진우 국민의힘 의원이 중앙선거관리위원회에서 제출받아 18일 공개한 서울 송파·강남·광진·동작·서초구 투표소 439곳의 투표록에는 투표용지 부족 상황 발생 뒤 벌어진 투표 시간 연장과 대기표 배부, 투표용지 추가 수송 등의 일련의 과정에서 투표관리인들과 유권자들이 겪었던 혼란이 고스란히 담겼다. 혼란이 극심했던 송파의 경우 올림픽공원 봉쇄 시위로 확보 불가한 투표록을 제외하고 52곳의 투표록이 공개됐다. )

item.title: 'National Assembly Audit of Election Commission' Passed in Plenary Session... Full-scale Investigation Begins Today for 45 Days (‘선관위 국조’ 국회 본회의 통과…오늘부터 45일간 본격 조사)
item.description:
A National Assembly audit to investigate the truth behind the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections and to reform election management will be conducted for 45 days starting from the 18th until August 1. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 진상규명과 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국회 국정조사가 18일부터 8월1일까지 45일 동안 진행된다.)

On the 18th, the National Assembly held a plenary session and passed the 'Plan for a National Assembly Audit to Investigate the Truth Behind the Violation of Citizens' Voting Rights, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and to Reform Election Management' with 250 votes in favor and 1 against (Independent Lawmaker Choi Hyeok-jin) out of 251 lawmakers present. (국회는 18일 본회의를 열어 재석 의원 251명 가운데 찬성 250명, 반대 1명(최혁진 무소속 의원)으로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사계획서’를 의결했다.)

The targeted institutions are the National Election Commission and election commissions at all levels. The scope of the investigation includes: △ the circumstances leading to the ballot paper shortage; △ whether the process for establishing ballot paper print quantity calculation standards was flawed; △ the appropriateness of the election commission's on-site management and post-incident response on the day of the incident; △ measures regarding assemblies and protests at polling and counting stations, and police actions, as well as an overall review of election management. The investigation period can be extended through a plenary session resolution. The special committee consists of a total of 18 members, including Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun from the People Power Party, 9 from the Democratic Party of Korea, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-negotiating groups (Reform Party Lawmaker Lee Jun-seok and Motherland Innovation Party Lawmaker Jeong Chun-saeng). (대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위다. 조사 범위는 △투표용지 부족 사태 발생 경위 △투표용지 인쇄 수량 산정 기준 수립 과정의 부실 여부 △사태 당일 선관위의 현장 관리·사후 대응 적절성 여부 △투·개표소 집회 시위 및 경찰 조치 사항, 선거관리 전반 점검 등이다. 조사 기간은 본회의 의결을 통해 연장할 수 있다. 특위는 국민의힘 소속인 윤상현 위원장을 포함해 더불어민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명(이준석 개혁신당 의원, 정춘생 조국혁신당 의원) 등 총 18명으로 꾸려졌다.)

In the plenary session, the ruling and opposition parties also agreed to handle 30 non-contentious bills, including a partial amendment to the Act on the Award of War Medals for the Korean War, which expands the scope of bereaved families of Korean War veterans, and the Bicycle Act, which provides a basis for regulating fixie bicycles without brakes. (여야는 본회의에서 6·25 전쟁 공로자 유가족 범위를 확대하는 6·25전쟁 무공훈장 수여 등에 관한 법률 일부개정법률안과 브레이크가 없는 픽시 자전거 규제 근거를 담은 자전거법 등 비쟁점 법안 30개도 합의 처리했다.)
